title: Klang Floods: Non-stop rain turns Jalan Meru into a river | The Star
text:
Klang Floods: Non-stop rain turns Jalan Meru into a river | The Star
KLANG: Non-stop rain has caused Jalan Meru in Klang to become flooded
A video posted on the Malaysian Chinese News Facebook page on Saturday (Dec 18) shows vehicles stuck along the centre divider on the road, some almost completely submerged.
